[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Amarith''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She commanded [[Chiron Base]] and dispatched a team of Rebels to investigate an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ando Project|operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]].<ref name="Ando" />
